name: Ichijou Ryuuya
source:
The protagonist. His mother remarried Tatsuo giving him a new step father and step sister. He passionately hates his new father. He starts out with a crush on his sister Konoha but she rejects him saying that siblings can't become lovers.

Because people only call him by his given name we never learn if he adopts his step-father's name, Ichijou.
